subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the win-back program for {Brand}, after my earlier emails on purchase-optimized retargeting and the Prime Day pull this week. If recovering abandoned baskets and proving incremental orders against a holdout are on your roadmap, I can share the recency-segment and ROAS read this week. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for when it is useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN ecommerce retargeting South Africa, native English. References prior outreach and both earlier stages (purchase-optimized retargeting + Prime Day pull) in first sentence so the cascade reads as one thread. Direct close with easy out, releasing the prospect if timing is wrong. No figure; zero question marks; no sign-off; no em-dash; no curly quotes; no 'X, not Y'.
